items.prompt: If Y=100X+7 and Var(X) is finite, what is Var(Y)?

options.why: Scale squared multiplies variance; deterministic shifts do not add spread.
That incorrectly treats variance as a linear operator.
Offsets do not create variance this way.
The transformation multiplies rather than divides scale.

items.explanation: Center Y by its own mean: the remaining deviation is 100(X-E[X]), whose square scales by 10000.
